mapper.insert: INSERT INTO b_portal_attachment ( portal_id, gmt_create, gmt_modify, file_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, file_ext, stage) VALUES ( #{portalId}, now(), now(), #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{fileExt}, #{stage});
mapper.select: SELECT id, portal_id AS portalId, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modify AS gmtModify, file_name AS fileName, file_path AS filePath, file_size AS fileSize, file_type AS fileType, file_ext AS fileExt, stage FROM b_portal_attachment WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER};

SELECT id, portal_id AS portalId, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modify AS gmtModify, file_name AS fileName, file_path AS filePath, file_size AS fileSize, file_type AS fileType, file_ext AS fileExt, stage FROM b_portal_attachment WHERE file_path = #{filePath};
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM b_portal_attachment WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER}
